at-home-care.title: In-Home Babysitter — Puerto Rico Metro Area | Titi Amanda
at-home-care.description: In-home childcare in San Juan, Carolina, Guaynabo, Bayamón and metro area. Screen-free play, routines respected, 8+ years of experience.
at-home-care.h1: In-home childcare in the metro area
intro: Caring for your child at home has one advantage no other arrangement matches: your child stays in their own environment, with their own toys, their own bed, and their routine intact. That dramatically reduces separation anxiety, especially with infants and preschoolers.

I come to your home in San Juan, Carolina, Guaynabo, Bayamón, and the metro area with activities prepared for your child's age, and I follow the routine you already have rather than imposing a new one. If your child naps at 2:00, they nap at 2:00.
includes: Prepared, age-appropriate activities with no screens
Existing meal, nap, and bedtime routines respected
Help with snacks and meals already prepared by the family
Spaces we used tidied up before I leave
A wrap-up when I finish: what they ate, how long they slept, how their mood was
how: Message me with dates, times, and your children's ages
Before the first session we go over routines, allergies, and anything important
I arrive 10 minutes early so you can leave unhurried

faq.q: Do you offer in-home babysitting in the metro area?
faq.a: Yes. I provide in-home babysitting in San Juan, Carolina, Guaynabo, Bayamón, and the greater Puerto Rico metro area. I come to your home with prepared activities and follow your family's routine. Message me with dates and ages to confirm availability.
The minimum booking is four hours. For specific dates or schedules, message me and we'll work it out.

faq.q: Can you watch more than one child?
faq.a: Yes. How many depends on their ages — two preschoolers is not the same as an infant plus a newborn. Tell me the ages and I'll be straight with you about whether I can give them all quality attention.

faq.q: Do you work nights and weekends?
faq.a: Yes, including date nights and events. Peak season and holiday dates fill up weeks ahead, so the earlier you reach out the better.

hotel-vacation.title: Hotel Babysitter — Metro Area, PR | Titi Amanda
hotel-vacation.description: Bilingual hotel babysitter in San Juan, Carolina, Guaynabo, Bayamón and metro area. Ideal for tourists, weddings, and nights out.
hotel-vacation.h1: Hotel and vacation babysitting in Puerto Rico
intro: Traveling with kids and never getting an adult dinner or excursion is the most common frustration for families visiting Puerto Rico. I come to your hotel or resort in San Juan, Condado, Isla Verde, or Dorado so you can go out with peace of mind.

I bring my own materials and activities, because a hotel room has nothing to keep a child engaged. I'm fluent in Spanish and English, so communication with your family and with hotel staff is never an obstacle.
includes: Care in the room, by the pool, or in the lobby — whatever the family prefers
Materials and activities I bring myself: books, art, games
Fully bilingual service in English and Spanish
Coordination with hotel staff when needed
Availability for destination weddings and events with extended hours
how: Message me with your hotel name, dates, and your children's ages
We arrange the meeting point and any hotel requirements
You get a check-in message during the session so you can relax

faq.q: Which hotels do you travel to?
faq.a: Hotels in San Juan, Condado, Isla Verde, Old San Juan, Carolina, and Dorado. If yours is outside that area, message me anyway and I'll tell you whether I can get there.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a: For peak season, weddings, and holidays, as early as possible — those dates fill weeks ahead. Off-season, a few days is usually enough.

faq.q: Can you provide care during a wedding or event?
faq.a: Yes, it's one of the most requested services from traveling families. Weddings are worth arranging well ahead since they usually involve several children from different families.

special-needs.title: Autism & Special Needs Sitter — Metro Area | Titi Amanda
special-needs.description: Specialized care for children with autism in the Puerto Rico metro area. Master's in Special Education and Autism.
special-needs.h1: Care for children with autism and developmental needs
intro: Finding someone equipped to care for a child with autism is hard, and leaving them with someone who doesn't understand their needs isn't an option. I hold a master's in Special Education and Autism, a master's in Psychological Counseling, and a bachelor's in Speech Therapy.

That means I'm not improvising: I work with visual supports, I preview transitions, I recognize signs of sensory overload before they escalate, and I respect whatever communication system your child already uses — spoken language, signs, or a device.
includes: Visual supports and transition previews to reduce anxiety
Sensory activities adapted to your child's profile
Early recognition of overload signals and regulation strategies
Respect for and use of the communication system your child already has
Continuity with the strategies used at home and in therapy
how: You tell me the diagnosis, the supports they use, and what works
We arrange a shorter first visit so they can meet me without pressure
I follow the strategies you already use at home — I don't invent new ones
I share how the session went and what worked best

faq.q: What specific training do you have?
faq.a: A bachelor's in Speech Therapy, a master's in Special Education and Autism, and a master's in Psychological Counseling, plus 8+ years of direct experience with children.

faq.q: Can you follow my child's therapy plan?
faq.a: Yes. I don't replace their therapists, but I do carry through the strategies they already use so your child doesn't lose ground between sessions.

faq.q: What if my child is non-speaking?
faq.a: I work with whatever communication system they already use: signs, picture cards, a device, or their own gestures. What matters is that they feel understood, not that they speak.

family-outing.title: Family Outing Support — Metro Area, PR | Titi Amanda
family-outing.description: Extra hands during outings and events with kids in San Juan, Carolina, Guaynabo, Bayamón and the metro area.
intro: Sometimes you don't need to leave the kids at home — you need another pair of hands while they're with you. Beach, restaurant, family event, a long errand: I come along so the outing is enjoyable instead of exhausting.

It's the ideal service for families with several children of different ages, when tending to one means losing sight of another. I handle the small logistics so you can actually be present with your kids.
includes: Support through the whole outing, not just occasional supervision
Focused attention on the youngest while you tend to the older ones
Help with snacks, changes of clothes, and all the kid gear
Close supervision in higher-risk places: beach, pool, open areas
Activities for the waiting stretches at restaurants and events
how: Tell me the plan: where you're going, how long, and how many children
We agree on a meeting point and what you need me to bring
I'm with you for the full outing

faq.q: Can you come with us to the beach or pool?
faq.a: Yes, and supervision is stricter in those settings because of the water. I'll ask that we agree ahead of time on the rules you want me to follow.

faq.q: Do you attend events and family weddings?
faq.a: Yes. At events I usually look after several children from the same family so the adults can take part.

faq.q: Do you drive yourself or ride with us?
faq.a: We arrange it based on the outing. I normally meet you there, but we can work out something else if that suits you better.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Titi Amanda
privacy.description: How Titi Amanda collects, uses, and protects information you share when requesting babysitting services in Puerto Rico.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information I collect when you use the contact form or message me, and how I use it to coordinate childcare services.

sections.title: Information I collect
sections.body: When you complete the form or contact me, I may receive your name, email, phone number, information about your children (names and ages), the service type requested, and any additional details you choose to share.

sections.title: How I use your information
sections.body: I use this information only to respond to inquiries, confirm availability, coordinate care, and follow up before and after a session. I do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing.

sections.title: Storage and security
sections.body: Form messages are sent through a secure automation service so I can respond promptly. I take reasonable steps to protect your information, though no online system is 100% secure.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask me to correct or delete information you have shared by emailing or messaging me on WhatsApp.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For questions about this policy, reach me at titiamandababysitter@gmail.com or WhatsApp at +1 (787) 585-7123.
